# Service & Outreach

## Committees and Organizations

```{r service, results='asis'}
library(lubridate)
vroom::vroom("data/committees-service.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    date_parsed = lubridate::my(start),
    start_fmt   = fmt_month(date_parsed),
    stop_parsed = suppressWarnings(lubridate::my(stop)),
    stop_fmt    = if_else(is.na(stop_parsed), stop, fmt_month(stop_parsed))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(date_parsed)) %>%
  mutate(line = glue::glue("- {with}, {where} ({start_fmt} {.en_dash} {stop_fmt})")) %>%
  pull(line) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n") %>%
  cat()
```

## Review Panels

```{r review-panels, results='asis'}
vroom::vroom("data/grant-service.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(date_parsed = lubridate::my(when)) %>%
  arrange(desc(date_parsed)) %>%
  mutate(line = glue::glue("- {who}, {position} ({fmt_month(date_parsed)})")) %>%
  pull(line) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n") %>%
  cat()
```
